target.title: fix(agents): MiniMax VLM can consume oversized success responses
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users invoking MiniMax VLM image understanding could have OpenClaw read an unbounded provider success response when MiniMax returns an unexpectedly large `200 OK` body. Non-OK MiniMax VLM responses already used a bounded diagnostic snippet, but successful JSON responses were not bounded before parsing.

## Why This Change Was Made

MiniMax VLM successful responses are now read through the shared bounded response reader before JSON parsing, with a 256 KiB response-body cap and Trace-Id included in overflow errors. This keeps normal valid VLM results unchanged and does not change request payloads, provider routing, timeout behavior, or non-OK error snippet handling.

## User Impact

Users and operators get bounded read behavior for malformed or oversized MiniMax VLM success responses. Normal MiniMax VLM image descriptions still return content as before; an oversized successful provider body now fails fast with a diagnostic error instead of being fully consumed.

## Evidence

Regression coverage now exercises an oversized successful MiniMax VLM JSON response and asserts that the response stream is cancelled before parsing the full body.

- Public proof excerpt: Validation `minimax-vlm-test` (pass, exit_code=0, 13283ms):
